[SWS_CM_02201] Static service connection
⌈
The static connection of services
which are bound to SOME/IP protocols shall be preformed by statically pre-configured
application end-points as described in the TPS_ManifestSpecification for a Provid-
edSomeipServiceInstance by [TPS_MANI_03312], [TPS_MANI_03313] and for a
RequiredSomeipServiceInstance by [TPS_MANI_03314], [TPS_MANI_03315],
[TPS_MANI_03316].
⌋
